suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare infection complication. Require acute Coxiella burnetii/Q fever and separately documented acalculous (alithiasic) cholecystitis attributable to the infection. Rare complication described in review; do not generalize to ordinary calculous gallbladder disease. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Coxiella Burnetii (Q Fever) and Cholecystitis / Gallbladder Disease
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
